messages:
Katie: Quick sync — Seabird trial pre-read + alignment. Meeting 9am PT tomorrow. High level: confirm success metrics, infra needs, security asks, and pricing. Who's in?
Jorge: I can do 9am. Need to confirm their latency and throughput SLOs before the call.
Amy: I'll prep the agenda and a short eval plan. Draft agenda: intros, success criteria, data/security constraints, eval harness, timeline + infra checklist. I'll drop doc link here in a bit. :memo:
Devon: From infra side: need network diagram and whether this is Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. If Private, we need SAML and IP allowlist details.
Sales Ops: On pricing — they mentioned ~2k requests/day with bursts. Do we want to propose a Dedicated trial or Hosted with burst credits? I can sketch a ballpark.
Katie: Use case summary for the call: RAG for support ticket triage, single-turn responses, occasional follow-ups. Target quality metric: top-1 relevance >= 85% on a 500-query eval set. Latency goal: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 700ms.
Amy: Prompts + evals plan: we'll run three prompt templates (clarify-first, direct-answer, multi-turn follow-up). Suggested eval harness: 500 labeled queries + heuristic fuzzy match for partial credit. I'll attach prompt examples in the pre-read.
Jorge: Security checklist note: they asked for SOC2, DPA, and IP ownership clarification. Also wants KMS support and token redaction. @Devon can we confirm KMS + redaction capabilities?
Devon: KMS: yes. Token redaction: yes but logging retention will need to be set to minimal and approved by legal. For Private deploys, network routing + HSM are doable but require lead time (2-3 weeks). Also will recommend quantized model variant (e.g., Llama2-70b-quant) for better latency/cost — we should call out tradeoffs.
Katie: Action items before the 9am: (1) Amy — share agenda + eval templates by EOD, (2) Devon — produce infra checklist + lead-time estimates, (3) Sales Ops — draft ballpark pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated trial, (4) Jorge — confirm legal/security asks and list required docs. I'll send calendar invite and pre-read link. Anything missing?
Jorge: Add stakeholders to invite: Seabird — Mira (CTO), Raj (ML Lead), Lena (SecOps). Also include Seabird PM Tara for product alignment.
Amy: Adding a tiny eval script snippet to pre-read:
```python
# simple eval loop
for q in queries:
    resp = client.generate(prompt_for(q))
    score = fuzzy_match(resp, gold[q])
    log(score)
```
Sales Ops: Pricing note: if they commit to a 3-month Dedicated trial we can offer a 20% trial discount and include one onboarding hour from Solutions Eng. I'll put numbers in the doc.
Katie: Perfect. I'll add a short pre-read: use cases, success metrics, infra asks, and the eval plan. See you all 9am PT — thanks! :coffee:
